summary: Learn public-service accountability, workflow mapping and performance reporting. Explore the five-day fundamentals course and see how it fits your role.
lede: Public administration training helps public-service staff and supervisors clarify mandates and organize accountable services. Learners practise assigning decision ownership with RACI, mapping service journeys, setting basic service measures and reviewing citizen feedback. They also use the PDCA cycle to plan process improvements and prepare concise updates on service results.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for people who carry out, coordinate or oversee public-sector administration and need practical methods for clarifying responsibility, managing service processes and reporting results.
modules: OECD Public Integrity in Daily Administration
Logic Models for Public Service Measures
prerequisites: No prior public administration training is assumed. Familiarity with routine workplace procedures can help you connect the exercises to your role.
